We train both models for a maximum of 70 epochs, and because we observed high variability across random seeds we use an early stopping patience of 30.

QA-GNN All parameters optimised with RAdam (Liu et al., 2020). Batch size is 128. A maximum of 128 tokens are input to the text encoder, which is trained with learning rate $1\mathrm{e} - 5$ but frozen for the first 4 epochs. The 5-layer GNN has 200-dimensional embeddings and is trained with learning rate $1\mathrm{e} - 3$ . Parameters have L2 weight decay of 0.01 applied.

MHGRN All parameters optimised with RAdam. Batch size is 32. A maximum of 128 tokens are input to the text encoder, which is trained with learning rate $1\mathrm{e} - 5$ but frozen for the first 3 epochs. The 1-layer GNN has 100-dimensional embeddings and is trained with learning rate $1\mathrm{e} - 3$ . Each layer performs 3-hop message passing. Parameters have L2 weight decay of 0.01 applied.

Standard deviations on the test set for each experiment are given in table 2, and development set scores in table 3. The average run times of these experiments on an Nvidia A100 GPU are shown in table 4, which correspond to the number of optimisation steps in table 5.
